title: The understanding critic: the card read again against the data before a solution is drawn, each concern a question
request: Phase 6 (the owner): the understanding team, with critic rounds; capture everything.
plan: A critic role in dclab_core: rules first, a model adding concerns, a validator.
A critic node before the workflow and the build, sending back to the interviewer.
Bound the rounds; never ask a field twice; keep every round.

decisions.decision: The critic never edits the card: each concern is a question for the person.
decisions.why: The person's words are the truth of the problem; a model's doubt is evidence for a question, not a change.

decisions.decision: One question a round, two rounds; concerns that stand go to the person as an approval.
decisions.why: The Home agent asks one thing at a time; the plan's third round stops with what the person sees, and the person may go on.

decisions.decision: A model's concern about what the person already answered is kept, not asked.
decisions.why: Nothing asked twice: the rules may send a field back with evidence; a model's doubt alone may not.

decisions.decision: The gate is a node of its own.
decisions.why: Resuming a pause re-runs its node; the critic's model must not be asked again on a resume.

change: dclab_core/understanding_critic.py and its prompt (dclab-core 0.68.0); the walk's critic and critic_gate nodes; the Home agent's critic questions (past the cap, re-opening a settled field, a bare yes keeping what is known, a family read and never stored as words); purpose understanding_critic; the agent eval and harness eval rerun for the prompt.

findings.defect: A critic's send-back on the family stored the person's raw words as the family.
findings.scenario: Family anomaly, stated; the critic asked whether it is anomaly detection; the answer Yes. made the family 'Yes.' and its status fell from stated to inferred.
findings.cause: family is not a plan field, so the answer was recorded as said.
findings.fix: A critic's question answered with a bare yes keeps what is known; a family is read from the answer through the card's reader, never stored as words.

findings.defect: The rounds did not match the plan: spent rounds passed silently.
findings.scenario: With rounds spent and concerns remaining the walk built and the concern was never shown; a concern refused because a question was open was dropped.
findings.cause: passed was set once the rounds were spent.
findings.fix: Concerns that stand when none can be sent back go to the person as an approval (go on, recorded as overridden; or stop with the concerns shown); while a critic's question is open the walk answers it first.

findings.scenario: Only the last round's concerns were kept.
findings.cause: One field held the last critique.
findings.fix: Every round kept: its concerns, the refused ones with why, what was sent back, the source.

findings.defect: A field the person had answered was asked again.
findings.scenario: The person answered the unit to the Home agent; the critic's model concern asked it again.
findings.cause: Only the critic's own asked fields were excluded.
findings.fix: A model's concern about an answered field is refused with its reason; the rules may still send back with evidence.

findings.defect: The harness gate failed after the prompt was added.
findings.scenario: test_harness_gate: core prompts changed since HRN-017.
findings.cause: A prompt change needs the agent eval and the harness eval (the repository's rule).
findings.fix: make agent-eval and make harness-eval rerun.

findings.defect: A model's question could name a column the tables do not hold.
findings.scenario: 'Is it per driver_rating?' with no columns listed was asked.
findings.cause: The validator read the listed columns only.
findings.fix: A backticked or snake_case name in a concern's words that is neither a column nor a card field refuses the answer; a number not in the evidence refuses that concern.

findings.defect: Mismatches mapped to the wrong field; several questions at once; no version, changelog or integration section.
findings.scenario: time_absent and unit_grain were sent back as the family; a round posted all its questions.
findings.cause: A two-way mapping; a loop over all concerns.
findings.fix: Each mismatch to the field it names; one question a round; dclab-core 0.68.0 with its changelog and section.

findings.defect: The new purpose had no data-limit test.
findings.scenario: check-quick failed: test_every_purpose_has_a_limit_and_a_test listed understanding_critic as untested.
findings.cause: A purpose was registered without the test that what it sends holds no cell.
findings.fix: A test: the critic on a marked table's data card (categories kept) sends names, purposes and bands, never a value.

measurements.name: the harness eval after the prompt (HRN-018)
measurements.gate: the regression cases and the dev journeys right on every step after a prompt change
measurements.result: 17 of 17 right on every step and part, EUR 0; the dev journeys through the graph with the critic's rules 15 of 15 (JRN-010)
measurements.against_gate: Met for the rules; the model critic is not measured.
limits: The critic's rules raise few concerns on these journeys: the send-back is exercised by tests, not measured on people.

outcome: Before a solution is drawn the card is read again against the tables, and what is still unsure goes back to the person as one question at a time, bounded, every round kept.
lessons: A send-back loop needs three bounds: rounds, fields, and what the person already said.
A model's words are evidence only when every name and number in them is in what it read.
risks: Not yet measured against the single Home agent (28.7); a model critic is off until it is.
